elements.label: Out-of-focus orange bokeh particle flying through foreground
Lower edge of left point-cloud head (particle drift)

pattern.description: A large, heavily blurred orange particle streaks diagonally from upper right to lower left past the camera and exits frame, in front of the in-focus point-cloud heads and captions.
pattern.why_premium: A defocused foreground element moving faster than the scene sells shallow depth of field and a 3D space around flat point clouds, at near-zero cost and without distracting from the caption.

build_hint.gsap: Foreground particle: gsap.fromTo(el, {x: 280, y: -200, scale: 0.6, filter: 'blur(18px)', opacity: 0.9}, {x: -260, y: 260, scale: 1.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.in'}); keep it on a top layer above heads and captions.
build_hint.remotion: const t = interpolate(frame, [0, 11], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.in(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translate = lerp([280,-200],[-260,260], t); scale = 0.6 + t; opacity = 1 - t; CSS filter blur(18px). Linear time path, no spring.

notes: The particle has left the frame by the end frame, so no candidate box contains it; b03 (union of the change area in the lower left) is used as the closest fit for its exit path. b02 is a tiny residual blur trace, omitted.
